<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@500;700;900&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#000;--bg2:#070b14;--blue:#1f7bff;--cyan:#19c3ff;--white:#fff;--mut:#9aa9c4;--line:rgba(25,195,255,.22);--wa:#25d366;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:80px;color-scheme:dark}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--white);font-family:'Manrope',system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.6;overflow-x:hidden}
h1,h2,h3,.logo{font-family:'Unbounded','Segoe UI',sans-serif;line-height:1.15}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:50;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:68px}

.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 12px 36px -6px rgba(31,123,255,.85)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--white)}
.btn.wa{background:var(--wa);color:#04210f}
.btn.wa:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 30px -8px rgba(37,211,102,.8)}
.btn svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:currentColor}
.hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:120px 0 60px;background:radial-gradient(60% 55% at 75% 50%,rgba(31,123,255,.3),transparent 70%),var(--bg)}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;width:100%}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,4.2rem);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.02em;animation:rise 1s .1s both cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--cyan)}
.hero p{margin:26px 0 36px;max-width:46ch;color:var(--mut);font-size:1.1rem;animation:rise 1s .3s both cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.cta{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;animation:rise 1s .5s both cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.scene{height:540px;perspective:1100px;display:grid;place-items:center;animation:rise 1.2s .4s both}
.rig{position:relative;width:340px;height:340px;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .15s ease-out}
.plate{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-style:preserve-3d;animation:sway 8s ease-in-out infinite}
.plate img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;mix-blend-mode:screen;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle,#000 55%,transparent 72%);mask-image:radial-gradient(circle,#000 55%,transparent 72%);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(25,195,255,.6))}
@keyframes sway{0%,100%{transform:rotateY(-18deg) rotateX(6deg) translateY(0)}50%{transform:rotateY(18deg) rotateX(-6deg) translateY(-18px)}}
.ring{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--blue);transform-style:preserve-3d}
.r1{width:440px;height:440px;margin:-220px 0 0 -220px;animation:ring1 10s linear infinite}
.r2{width:540px;height:540px;margin:-270px 0 0 -270px;border-color:var(--white);border-style:dashed;opacity:.45;animation:ring2 16s linear infinite}
@keyframes ring1{from{transform:rotateX(74deg) rotateZ(0)}to{transform:rotateX(74deg) rotateZ(360deg)}}
@keyframes ring2{from{transform:rotateY(72deg) rotateZ(0)}to{transform:rotateY(72deg) rotateZ(-360deg)}}
.ring i{position:absolute;top:-8px;left:50%;width:14px;height:14px;margin-left:-7px;background:var(--cyan);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 18px var(--cyan)}
.shard{position:absolute;width:14px;height:14px;background:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--blue);animation:float 6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes float{50%{transform:translate3d(0,-26px,60px) rotate(180deg)}}
section{padding:100px 0}
.head{max-width:680px;margin-bottom:50px}
.head h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.6vw,2.8rem);font-weight:700}
.head p{margin-top:16px;color:var(--mut)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;perspective:1000px}
.card{position:relative;padding:32px 26px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg2),#000);transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .2s ease-out,border-color .3s;will-change:transform;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;display:block;width:100%}
.card:hover{border-color:var(--cyan)}
.card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;background:radial-gradient(260px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,0%),rgba(25,195,255,.22),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:none}
.card:hover::after{opacity:1}
.ico{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--cyan));margin-bottom:20px;transform:translateZ(50px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px -8px rgba(31,123,255,.8)}
.ico svg{width:26px;height:26px;stroke:#fff;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.card h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:10px;transform:translateZ(34px)}
.card p{color:var(--mut);font-size:.93rem;transform:translateZ(20px)}
.more{display:inline-block;margin-top:16px;color:var(--cyan);font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;transform:translateZ(26px)}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:34px}
.tab{padding:10px 22px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;transition:.25s}
.tab:hover{border-color:var(--cyan)}
.tab.on{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--cyan));border-color:transparent}
.shop{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#000,var(--bg2) 50%,#000)}
.items{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;perspective:1000px}
.item{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden;transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow .35s;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.item:hover{transform:translateY(-10px) rotateX(6deg);box-shadow:0 30px 50px -22px rgba(31,123,255,.9)}
.pic{height:190px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 55%,rgba(31,123,255,.5),transparent 70%)}
.pic svg{width:130px;height:130px;animation:bob 4s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 18px rgba(25,195,255,.35))}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(-10px) rotateY(18deg)}}
.item div.tx{padding:18px 20px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex:1}
.item h3{font-size:.98rem}
.item p{color:var(--mut);font-size:.88rem;flex:1}
.item .btn{margin-top:12px;padding:11px 18px;font-size:.9rem;justify-content:center}
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(0,0,0,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;perspective:1200px;overflow-y:auto}
.ov.on{display:flex}
.md{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:auto;padding:36px 30px 30px;border:1px solid var(--cyan);border-radius:22px;background:radial-gradient(90% 60% at 100% 0,rgba(31,123,255,.3),transparent 70%),var(--bg2);box-shadow:0 0 60px -10px rgba(31,123,255,.7);animation:pop .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2)}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:rotateX(-35deg) translateY(40px) scale(.9)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.md h3{font-size:1.25rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.md>p,.sub{color:var(--mut);margin-bottom:22px;font-size:.95rem}
.x{position:absolute;top:14px;right:16px;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-size:1.2rem}
.x:hover{border-color:var(--cyan)}
.back{background:none;border:0;color:var(--cyan);cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:14px;padding:0}
.opt{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:#000;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}
.opt:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);transform:translateX(6px) translateZ(0)}
.opt b{display:block;font-family:'Unbounded',sans-serif;font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:4px}
.opt span{color:var(--mut);font-size:.88rem}
form{display:grid;gap:14px}
input[type=tel],input[type=email],input[type=text]{width:100%;padding:15px 18px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#000;color:var(--white);font:inherit}
input:focus{border-color:var(--cyan);outline:none}

.warn{padding:12px 16px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(25,195,255,.12);border:1px solid var(--cyan);color:var(--white);font-size:.9rem}
.err{color:#ff8a8a;font-size:.9rem;min-height:1.2em}

.go h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3.4vw,2.6rem);margin-bottom:14px}

footer{padding:32px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mut);font-size:.9rem}
footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.fab{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:60;width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--wa);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 10px 30px -4px rgba(37,211,102,.7);animation:pulse 2.4s infinite}
.fab svg{width:32px;height:32px;fill:#04210f}
@keyframes pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(37,211,102,.6)}70%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 20px rgba(37,211,102,0)}}
@media(max-width:900px){nav ul{display:none}.hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.scene{height:420px;transform:scale(.8)}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.items{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
.rig{width:100%;max-width:440px;height:340px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.emb{width:min(210px,52vw);mix-blend-mode:screen;transform:translateZ(70px);animation:bob2 4s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 24px rgba(25,195,255,.6))}
@keyframes bob2{50%{transform:translateZ(70px) translateY(-12px)}}
.scene{height:460px}
.word{display:flex;transform-style:preserve-3d;font-family:'Unbounded','Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(1.9rem,8.4vw,3.6rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:.04em;animation:sway 9s ease-in-out infinite}

.lt s{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;text-decoration:none}

.lt.cy b{color:var(--cyan)}

.pg{animation:pgin .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
@keyframes pgin{from{opacity:0;transform:perspective(1200px) rotateY(14deg) translateX(40px)}}

.phero{padding:120px 0 30px;background:radial-gradient(55% 60% at 78% 45%,rgba(31,123,255,.3),transparent 70%)}
.phero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:30px;align-items:center}

.phero p{color:var(--mut);max-width:46ch;animation:rise .8s .15s both}
.back{color:var(--cyan);font-weight:700}

@keyframes spinY{to{transform:rotateY(360deg)}}
.obj{position:relative;width:300px;height:300px;transform-style:preserve-3d;animation:sway 8s ease-in-out infinite}
.big{width:100%;height:100%;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(25,195,255,.5))}
.beam{position:absolute;left:70%;top:20%;width:240px;height:120px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(25,195,255,.6),transparent);clip-path:polygon(0 45%,100% 0,100% 100%,0 55%);transform-origin:0 50%;animation:scan 3s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes scan{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-20deg)}50%{transform:rotate(25deg)}}

@keyframes rs{to{transform:rotateX(75deg) rotateZ(360deg)}}
.glow .big{animation:hue 5s linear infinite}

@keyframes lapt{50%{transform:rotateX(22deg) rotateY(28deg)}}
.lid{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:260px;height:170px;border-radius:10px;border:4px solid #cfd8ea;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#1f7bff,#19c3ff 35%,#050b18 90%);transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:lid 9s ease-in-out infinite;overflow:hidden}
.code{position:absolute;inset:20px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.75) 0 4px,transparent 4px 14px);-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 60%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 60%,transparent);animation:cd2 3s linear infinite}
@keyframes cd2{50%{opacity:.4}}

.bas{position:absolute;left:-6px;top:170px;width:272px;height:150px;border-radius:6px 6px 16px 16px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#9aa9c4 0 20px,#7d8aa6 20px 22px),#cfd8ea;background-size:100% 100%;transform-origin:top;transform:rotateX(90deg);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 6px #cfd8ea}
.duo{display:flex;gap:70px;transform-style:preserve-3d;transform:rotateX(-8deg)}
.duo .phone:nth-child(2){animation-delay:-4s}
.phone{position:relative;width:100px;height:200px;transform-style:preserve-3d;transform-origin:50% 50% -5px;animation:spinY 8s linear infinite}
.phone>*{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:18px}
.phone .e{background:var(--c);filter:brightness(.78)}
.phone .scr{background:linear-gradient(165deg,#1f7bff,#19c3ff 40%,#04101f 90%);border:5px solid #0a1220;backface-visibility:hidden}
.phone .scr::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:8px;left:50%;width:30px;height:9px;margin-left:-15px;border-radius:6px;background:#000}
.phone .bk{transform:translateZ(-9px) rotateY(180deg);background:var(--c);backface-visibility:hidden}
.cm{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;border-radius:12px;background-color:#0a1220;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-size:20px 20px;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,#19c3ff 0 4px,#000 5px 8px,transparent 9px),radial-gradient(circle,#19c3ff 0 4px,#000 5px 8px,transparent 9px),radial-gradient(circle,#19c3ff 0 4px,#000 5px 8px,transparent 9px)}
.iph{--c:#d9e2f2}.iph .cm{width:46px;height:46px;background-position:2px 2px,24px 2px,13px 24px}
.sam{--c:#1a2238}.sam .cm{width:22px;height:72px;background-color:transparent;background-position:1px 0,1px 24px,1px 48px}
.pw{width:100px;height:200px;transform:scale(.7)}
.pic{perspective:900px}

.coin .bk{transform:rotateY(180deg);font-size:1.7rem}
.fwrap{margin-top:34px}
.fm{max-width:640px;padding:34px 30px;border:1px solid var(--cyan);border-radius:22px;background:radial-gradient(90% 60% at 100% 0,rgba(31,123,255,.3),transparent 70%),var(--bg2);box-shadow:0 0 60px -14px rgba(31,123,255,.7);animation:pop .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2)}
.fm h3{font-size:1.2rem;margin-bottom:6px}
select,input[type=number]{width:100%;padding:15px 18px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#000;color:var(--white);font:inherit}
select:focus{border-color:var(--cyan);outline:none}
.fl{display:grid;gap:6px;color:var(--mut);font-size:.9rem}

.item{position:relative}

.o3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}

.lay{display:grid;grid-template-columns:250px 1fr;max-width:1380px;margin:0 auto;padding-top:68px}
.side{position:sticky;top:68px;align-self:start;height:calc(100vh - 68px);overflow-y:auto;padding:24px 14px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}

details{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:12px;background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden}
summary{cursor:pointer;padding:18px 20px;font-weight:700;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
summary::after{content:"+";color:var(--cyan);font-size:1.4rem;line-height:1;transition:transform .3s}
details[open]{border-color:var(--cyan)}
details[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(45deg)}
details p{padding:0 20px 18px;color:var(--mut);animation:rise .4s}
textarea{width:100%;padding:15px 18px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#000;color:var(--white);font:inherit;resize:vertical}
textarea:focus{border-color:var(--cyan);outline:none}
.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
footer .wrap.fw2{display:block}
.fcols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr;gap:30px;margin-bottom:26px}
.fcols h4{font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif;color:#fff;margin-bottom:8px}
.fcols a{display:block;color:var(--mut);margin:5px 0}
.fcols a:hover{color:#fff}
.fcols p{margin-top:10px;max-width:34ch}
.copy{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:18px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font-size:.85rem}
@media(max-width:1180px){.mc .phero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:900px){.lay{grid-template-columns:1fr}.side{position:sticky;top:68px;z-index:40;height:auto;flex-direction:row;overflow-x:auto;padding:10px 14px;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(0,0,0,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);gap:8px}.side h4{display:none}.side a{white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px}.side a:hover{transform:none}.g4{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.fcols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:560px){.g4,.fcols{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
:root{--ma:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}
.mas{background:var(--ma) center/contain no-repeat;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(25,195,255,.45))}
.rig{height:430px}.scene{height:530px}
.hm{width:min(250px,62vw);height:240px;transform:translateZ(80px);animation:mb 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes mb{0%,100%{transform:translateZ(80px) translateY(0) rotate(-3deg)}50%{transform:translateZ(80px) translateY(-16px) rotate(3deg)}}
@keyframes mb2{50%{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(4deg)}}
@keyframes jump{40%{transform:translateY(-26px)}}
@keyframes bp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateZ(110px) scale(.6)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateZ(110px) scale(1)}}
.bub{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:14px 14px 14px 2px;background:#fff;color:#04101f;font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;animation:bp .8s 1.2s both cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.3)}
.rel{position:relative}
.pk{position:absolute;right:24px;top:-60px;width:150px;height:150px;animation:mb2 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.side .sm{margin-top:auto;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg2),#000)}
.sm .mas{width:96px;height:96px;margin:0 auto 6px;animation:mb2 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.sm p{color:var(--mut);font-size:.85rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.side .sm a.btn{display:inline-flex;padding:9px 16px;font-size:.85rem;color:#04210f;gap:8px}
.side .sm a.btn:hover{color:#04210f;background:var(--wa);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.ok2{width:120px;height:120px;margin:0 auto 10px;animation:jump 1.2s ease-in-out 3}
.doc{position:relative}
.doc::after{content:"";display:block;width:130px;height:130px;margin:30px 0 0 auto;background:var(--ma) center/contain no-repeat;animation:mb2 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.soc{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;padding:30px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;background:radial-gradient(70% 100% at 0 50%,rgba(31,123,255,.3),transparent 70%),var(--bg2);flex-wrap:wrap}
.sc{width:170px;height:170px;flex:none;animation:mb2 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.soc h2{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.2rem);margin-bottom:8px}
.soc p{color:var(--mut);margin-bottom:18px}
.btn.ig{background:linear-gradient(45deg,#f9ce34,#ee2a7b 55%,#6228d7)}
.btn.ig svg{fill:none;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2}
.go .btn{margin:6px}
.pay{margin-top:40px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#04122b,#000 55%,#04122b);border-top:1px solid var(--cyan)}
.pay .pay-in{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 150px;gap:36px;align-items:center;padding:38px 24px}
.pay h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:16px}
.pms{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pi{width:128px;padding:14px 10px 10px;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;color:#0a1220;display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;transition:transform .3s}
.pi:hover{transform:perspective(500px) rotateY(14deg) translateY(-6px)}
.pi svg{width:62px;height:40px}
.lg{height:40px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.nq{font-weight:800;font-size:1.45rem;color:#da0081;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.bc{background:#fdda24;border-radius:8px;padding:0 9px;color:#1a1a1a;font-weight:800;font-size:.76rem;gap:5px}
.bc svg{width:16px;height:14px}
.ad p{color:#cdd6e8;margin-bottom:10px}
.ad a{color:var(--cyan);font-weight:700}
.pay .mas{width:150px;height:150px;animation:mb2 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.fcols{grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr 1.2fr}
.fmas{width:110px;height:110px;margin-top:12px;animation:mb2 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@media(max-width:1180px){.pay .pay-in{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.pay .mas{display:none}}
@media(max-width:900px){.scene{height:480px}.fcols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.side .sm{display:none}.pk{width:100px;height:100px;top:-30px}}
@media(max-width:700px){.pay .pay-in{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:560px){.scene{height:450px}.fcols{grid-template-columns:1fr}.pk{display:none}}
</style>
</head>

 };

addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
 var r=$('rig');if(r)r.style.transform='rotateX('+((e.clientY/innerHeight-.5)*-30)+'deg) rotateY('+((e.clientX/innerWidth-.5)*30)+'deg)';
 var c=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('.tilt');if(!c)return;
 var b=c.getBoundingClientRect(),px=(e.clientX-b.left)/b.width,py=(e.clientY-b.top)/b.height;
 c.style.transform='rotateY('+((px-.5)*18)+'deg) rotateX('+((.5-py)*18)+'deg) translateZ(10px)';c.style.setProperty('--mx',px*100+'%');c.style.setProperty('--my',py*100+'%');
});
document.addEventListener('pointerout',function(e){var c=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('.tilt');if(c&&!c.contains(e.relatedTarget))c.style.transform=''});
route();
</script>
</body>
</html>
